name: Exp_UltraFatl_Duplex
summary: This EA implements a duplex (dual-direction) trend-following strategy based on the UltraFatl digital filter indicator, opening both long and short positions based on multi-layer digital signal processing. It uses a sophisticated cascade of adaptive filters to identify trend direction and generates entry signals when multiple filter layers align, with built-in position management and trailing mechanisms.
summary_zh: 该EA基于UltraFatl数字滤波指标实现双向趋势跟踪策略，通过多层自适应数字滤波器的级联处理来识别趋势方向，当多个滤波层一致时产生入场信号，内置仓位管理和追踪止损机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于UltraFatl数字滤波器，这是一种多层级联自适应滤波技术，通过对价格序列进行多频段分解来提取趋势信号。入场条件为当所有滤波层（FATL、FTL、RFTL等）方向一致时开仓，即多头信号时买入、空头信号时卖出，实现双向交易。出场条件包括滤波器方向反转时平仓、固定止盈止损触发平仓以及追踪止损保护利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式，支持自定义仓位比例。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和单笔最大亏损比例控制，但仍缺乏整体账户风险敞口的全面管理。该策略适合在趋势明确的市场环境中运行，在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on the UltraFatl digital filter, a multi-layer cascade adaptive filtering technology that extracts trend signals by decomposing price series across multiple frequency bands. Entry conditions require all filter layers (FATL, FTL, RFTL, etc.) to align in the same direction - buy on bullish signal alignment and sell on bearish signal alignment, enabling duplex dual-direction trading. Exit conditions include closing positions when filter direction reverses, fixed take-profit and stop-loss triggers, and trailing stop mechanisms to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic lot calculation based on account balance with customizable position ratios. Money management implements maximum position limits and per-trade maximum loss percentage controls, but still lacks comprehensive overall account risk exposure management. The strategy performs best in clearly trending markets and may generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses in ranging or choppy market conditions.

pros: 多层滤波器级联设计有效过滤市场噪音，信号质量高于单一指标策略
双向交易机制能在上涨和下跌趋势中均获利，不依赖单边行情
内置追踪止损功能有效保护已有利润，降低盈利回吐风险
pros_en: Multi-layer cascade filter design effectively filters market noise, producing higher quality signals than single-indicator strategies
Duplex dual-direction trading mechanism captures profits in both uptrend and downtrend markets without relying on unidirectional movement
Built-in trailing stop functionality effectively protects accumulated profits and reduces the risk of profit givebacks
cons: 数字滤波器在震荡市场中容易产生虚假信号，导致频繁开平仓造成手续费侵蚀
滤波器参数固定缺乏自适应调整机制，无法根据市场波动率变化动态优化
追踪止损和固定止损的配合逻辑可能存在冲突，在剧烈波动中止损可能失效
cons_en: Digital filters tend to generate false signals in ranging markets, causing frequent open/close cycles that erode profits through transaction costs
Fixed filter parameters lack adaptive adjustment mechanisms, unable to dynamically optimize based on changing market volatility regimes
Potential conflict between trailing stop and fixed stop-loss logic may cause stop-loss failure during extreme volatility spikes
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在震荡市中自动暂停交易以减少虚假信号
引入自适应滤波器参数调整机制，根据ATR或市场波动率动态优化滤波器周期和阈值
improvements_en: Add market regime identification module (e.g., ADX or volatility filter) to automatically pause trading during ranging markets and reduce false signals
Introduce adaptive filter parameter adjustment mechanism to dynamically optimize filter periods and thresholds based on ATR or market volatility

risk_points: 数字滤波器在趋势转折点存在滞后性，可能导致入场延迟和出场不及时
双向交易在无明显趋势时可能同时触发多空信号造成双向亏损
缺乏整体账户风险敞口限制，极端行情下可能超出可承受亏损范围
risk_points_en: Digital filter lag at trend reversal points may cause delayed entries and untimely exits
Duplex trading may trigger both long and short signals simultaneously during directionless markets, causing losses on both sides
Lack of overall account risk exposure limits may exceed tolerable loss ranges during extreme market conditions

It uses a sophisticated cascade of adaptive filters to identify trend direction and generates entry signals when multiple filter layers align, with built-in position management and trailing mechanisms.
